grading_breakdown.reason: 5 P1 findings exceed the C-grade ceiling of 2; spec coverage 0% is below all grade thresholds

escalations.title: Handlebars.js ≤4.7.8 — AST Injection / Remote Code Execution
escalations.reason: CVSS 9.8 RCE; attack surface depends on whether user-supplied templates are processed — requires TheGuardians code-path audit

escalations.title: Vitest ≤3.2.5 — Arbitrary File Read and Code Execution via UI Server
escalations.reason: CVSS 9.8; Vitest UI server allows any network peer to read files and execute code without auth

escalations.title: Protobufjs ≤7.5.4 — Arbitrary Code Execution via Unsafe Code Generation
escalations.reason: CVSS 9.8 RCE; attack surface depends on whether orchestrator receives untrusted protobuf data

p1_findings.title: Domain spec 0% traced in source — 65 FRs unimplemented or unlinked
p1_findings.detail: 65 functional requirements in Specifications/dev-workflow-platform.md have zero // Verifies: FR-NNN comments in Source/. Entire feature areas (SQLite, Feature Request APIs, Bug Report APIs, Dev Cycle, Pipeline, OTel) are unimplemented or unlinked.
p1_findings.recommendation: Add // Verifies: FR-XXX comments to source for each implemented requirement. Mark deferred FRs in the spec. Fix enforcer to detect the gap automatically (QO-002).

p1_findings.title: Traceability enforcer blind to Specifications/ — false-passing CI gate
p1_findings.detail: Enforcer auto-selects the most-recently-modified Plans/ requirements file (13 FRs). It never reads Specifications/. Reports PASSED while 75 domain-spec FRs are untraced.
p1_findings.recommendation: Extend enforcer to also scan Specifications/ for FR-\d+ patterns. Fail CI if domain-spec coverage < 40%.

p2_findings.title: Route handlers call store directly — service layer bypassed
p2_findings.detail: 10+ direct store.* calls in route handlers. Business logic embedded in routes instead of services. Prevents isolation testing.
p2_findings.recommendation: Extract all store access into service functions. Route handlers should only parse, delegate, and serialize.

p2_findings.title: Logger always emits raw JSON — missing dev pretty-print mode
p2_findings.detail: process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(entry)) with no NODE_ENV check. Violates both plan-level and domain-spec requirements for pretty-printing in development.
p2_findings.recommendation: Add NODE_ENV === 'development' branch for human-readable log output.

p2_findings.title: Two logger modules with split call signatures
p2_findings.detail: src/utils/logger.ts (named export) is the canonical impl; src/logger.ts is a wrapper default export. workItemStore.ts imports the named export directly; all other files import the wrapper. Split interface: store calls logger.info('msg', ctx); routes call logger.info({msg, ...ctx}).
p2_findings.recommendation: Delete src/logger.ts. Standardize all imports to src/utils/logger.ts with the logger.info(msg, ctx) signature.

p2_findings.title: Duplicate test files for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p2_findings.detail: Two test files per component with diverging mocks and assertions. Creates maintenance trap and redundant CI time.
p2_findings.recommendation: Remove root-level tests/WorkItemDetailPage and tests/WorkItemListPage. Keep tests/pages/ versions (more complete). Verify no test cases exist exclusively in root versions before deleting.

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion ≤1.1.15 — DoS via exponential glob expansion
form-data 4.0.0–4.0.5 — CRLF injection in multipart headers
p2_findings.fix: npm update form-data (in both Backend and Frontend)

p2_findings.title: js-yaml — code injection via unsafe YAML deserialization
path-to-regexp <0.1.13 — ReDoS via crafted route parameters
vite ≤5.x — dev server SSRF / information disclosure

p3_findings.title: Layout, PriorityBadge, StatusBadge, TypeBadge — no test files
p3_findings.recommendation: Add tests/components/*.test.tsx for each; verify correct CSS class per enum value.

p3_findings.title: eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps without justification comment
p3_findings.recommendation: Add inline comment explaining why dependency is intentionally omitted, or fix the dependency array.

p3_findings.title: uuid ^9.0.0 — weak random number generation in certain contexts
Express/qs — invalid limit disables body size enforcement; invalid charset causes DoS
postcss <8.5.10 — XSS via unescaped </style> in CSS output
react-router-dom 6.7.0–6.30.3 — open redirect via protocol-relative URLs
Remaining 9 medium CVEs (vitest mocker SSRF, protobufjs/utf8, handlebars prototype pollution x2, protobufjs DoS+prototype x2, dockerode uuid, body-parser)
p3_findings.fix: npm update in respective project directories
